mapper.select: SELECT fr.FosterID as fosterId, af.ApptID as apptId, fr.PetID as petId, p.PetName as petName, fr.StartDate as startDate, fr.EndDate as endDate, fr.FosterFee as fosterFee, fr.FosterStatus as fosterStatus, IFNULL(s.StoreName, '未知门店') as storeName FROM fosterRecord fr LEFT JOIN pet p ON fr.PetID = p.PetID LEFT JOIN store s ON fr.StoreID = s.StoreID LEFT JOIN apptFoster af ON fr.FosterID = af.FosterID WHERE p.UserID = #{userId} AND p.PetID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fr.StartDate DESC

SELECT fr.FosterID as fosterId, fr.PetID as petId, IFNULL(p.PetName, '未知宠物') as petName, u.UserID as userId, IFNULL(u.UserName, '未知用户') as userName, fr.StoreID as storeId, IFNULL(s.StoreName, '未知门店') as storeName, fr.EmpID as empId, IFNULL(e.EmpName, '未知员工') as empName, fr.StartDate as startDate, fr.EndDate as endDate, fr.FosterFee as fosterFee, fr.FosterStatus as fosterStatus FROM fosterRecord fr LEFT JOIN pet p ON fr.PetID = p.PetID LEFT JOIN user u ON p.UserID = u.UserID LEFT JOIN store s ON fr.StoreID = s.StoreID LEFT JOIN employee e ON fr.EmpID = e.EmpID WHERE fr.EmpID = #{empId} AND fr.FosterID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fr.StartDate DESC

SELECT fr.FosterID as fosterId, fr.PetID as petId, IFNULL(p.PetName, '未知宠物') as petName, u.UserID as userId, IFNULL(u.UserName, '未知用户') as userName, fr.StoreID as storeId, IFNULL(s.StoreName, '未知门店') as storeName, fr.EmpID as empId, IFNULL(e.EmpName, '未知员工') as empName, fr.StartDate as startDate, fr.EndDate as endDate, fr.FosterFee as fosterFee, fr.FosterStatus as fosterStatus FROM fosterRecord fr LEFT JOIN pet p ON fr.PetID = p.PetID LEFT JOIN user u ON p.UserID = u.UserID LEFT JOIN store s ON fr.StoreID = s.StoreID LEFT JOIN employee e ON fr.EmpID = e.EmpID WHERE fr.FosterID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fr.StartDate DESC

SELECT fr.FosterID as fosterId, fr.PetID as petId, IFNULL(p.PetName, '未知宠物') as petName, IFNULL(p.Breed, '未知品种') as breed, CASE p.Gender WHEN 'M' THEN '公' WHEN 'F' THEN '母' ELSE '未知' END as gender, u.UserID as userId, IFNULL(u.UserName, '未知用户') as userName, IFNULL(u.Phone, '未填写') as userPhone, fr.StoreID as storeId, IFNULL(s.StoreName, '未知门店') as storeName, IFNULL(s.StoreAddress, '未填写') as storeAddress, IFNULL(s.StorePhone, '未填写') as storePhone, fr.EmpID as empId, IFNULL(e.EmpName, '未知员工') as empName, IFNULL(e.EmpPhone, '未填写') as empPhone, IFNULL(e.Position, '未填写') as empPosition, fr.StartDate as startDate, fr.EndDate as endDate, fr.FosterFee as fosterFee, fr.FosterStatus as fosterStatus, IFNULL(fr.FosterRemarks, '无') as fosterRemarks, IFNULL(fr.DailyStatus, '无') as dailyStatus FROM fosterRecord fr LEFT JOIN pet p ON fr.PetID = p.PetID LEFT JOIN user u ON p.UserID = u.UserID LEFT JOIN store s ON fr.StoreID = s.StoreID LEFT JOIN employee e ON fr.EmpID = e.EmpID WHERE fr.FosterID = #{fosterId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fosterRecord fr WHERE fr.EmpID = #{empId} AND fr.FosterID IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fosterRecord fr WHERE fr.FosterID IS NOT NULL
